q_en: If A can do a work in 21 days and B can do the same work in 28 days. In how many days will they complete the work if they work on alternate days?
e_en: A's work time = 21 days B's work time = 28 days Find time to complete work if A and B work alternately Concept: Work done is inversely proportional to time taken. If they work on alternate days, their work done adds up. Solution: A's work/day = 1/21 B's work/day = 1/28 Work done by A and B in 2 days = 1/21 + 1/28 = 4/84 + 3/84 = 7/84 Time taken for 1 complete work = 2 × 84/7 = 24 days Hence, they will complete the work in 24 days.

q_en: On certain sum, the simple interest for 2 years is Rs. 12000. If the sum is Rs. 12000, then what will be the compound interest (compounding annually) on the same sum at the same rate of interest for the first 3 years?
e_en: Principal (P) = Rs. 12000 Simple interest (SI) for 2 years = Rs. 12000 Find compound interest (CI) for 3 years Concept: Rate of interest can be calculated from SI, then applied to calculate CI. Solution: Rate of interest (r) = (SI × 100)/(P × t) = (12000 × 100)/(12000 × 2) = 50% per annum CI for 3 years at 50% per annum = P[(1 + r/100)3 - 1] = 12000[(1 + 50/100)3 - 1] CI = 12000[(3/2)3 - 1] = 12000[27/8 - 1] = Rs. 28500

q_en: A bus travels 166 Km in 3 hours and then travels the next 2 hours at 134 Km/hr. Find the average speed of the bus
e_en: Given: Distance travelled in first 3 hours = 166 Km Duration of first journey = 3 hours Speed during next 2 hours = 134 Km/hr Duration of second journey = 2 hours Formula: Average speed = Total distance/Total time Solution: ⇒ Total distance = 166 Km + (134 Km/hr x 2 hr) ⇒ Total distance = 166 Km + 268 Km ⇒ 434 Km ⇒ Total time = 3 hr + 2 hr ⇒ 5 hr ⇒ Average speed = 434 Km/5 hr ⇒ Average speed = 86.8 Km/hr Therefore, the average speed of the bus is 86.8 Km/hr.

q_en: The numbers are in the ratio of 3 ∶ 5. If their HCF is 11, then find the sum of two numbers.
e_en: Given: Ratio of two numbers = 3 : 5 HCF of the two numbers = 11 Formula: Numbers are equal to the product of HCF and the respective ratios. Solution: ⇒ First number = 3 × HCF = 3 × 11 = 33 ⇒ Second number = 5 × HCF = 5 × 11 = 55 ⇒ Sum of two numbers = First number + Second number = 33 + 55 = 88 Therefore, the sum of the two numbers is 88.

q_en: A sum becomes Rs. 14,400 in 3 years and Rs. 15,500 in 4 years at simple interest. Find the sum.

q_en: A shopkeeper allows a discount of 20% on the marked price and still gains 12% on the whole. Find at what percent above the cost price did he mark his goods?
e_en: Given: Discount = 20% Profit = 12% Formula Used: Selling price = Cost price + Profit Selling price = Marked price – Discount Calculation: Let the cost price be Rs. ‘x’ Profit = 12% of x ⇒ 0.12x Selling price = Cost price + Profit ⇒ x + 0.12x ⇒ 1.12x Now, Selling price = Marked price – Discount ⇒ 1.12x = MP – 20% of MP ⇒ 1.12x = MP – (1/5)MP ⇒ 1.12x = (4/5)MP ⇒ MP = 5 × 1.12x/4 ⇒ MP = 1.4x ⇒ MP = x + 40% of x ∴ The market price should be 40% above the cost price.

Formula Used: SI = (P × R × T)/100 Calculation: ⇒ P(6 × 5/100 - 5 × 4/100) = 422 ⇒ P(30/100 - 20/100) = 422 ⇒ P(10/100) = 422 ⇒ P(1/10) = 422 ⇒ P = 4220 ∴ The correct answer is 4220.

q_en: What is the average of first 57 natural numbers?
e_en: Formula Used: Sum of first n natural numbers = n(n + 1)/2 Calculation: Sum of first 57 natural number = 57(57 + 1)/2 = 57 × 58/2 = 1653 Average = 1653/57 = 29 ∴ The correct answer is 29.

q_en: The outer radius of a spherical shell is 13 cm and the thickness of the shell is 3 cm. What is the volume of the metal used for the shell? (π = 22/7)
e_en: Given: Outer radius of a spherical shell is 13 cm and the thickness of the shell is 3 cm. Formula Used: Volume of sphere = 4/3πr³ Calculation: Volume of the metal used = Voulme of outer surface - Volume of inner surface ⇒ 4/3π[13³ - 10³] ⇒ 4/3π[2197 - 1000] ⇒ 4/3π[1197] ⇒ 4/3 × 22/7 × 1197 ⇒ 4/3 × 22 × 171 ⇒ 4 × 22 × 57 ⇒ 5016 cm³ ∴ The correct answer is 5016 cm³.

q_en: Seema alone can do a piece of work in 8 days and her sister Reema alone can do the same work in 24 days. If they worked together, then in how many days they will complete the work?

q_en: The volume of a hemisphere is 486π cm³. Find the radius.

q_en: A man buys 13 pens for a rupee. How many pens should he sell for a rupee to earn a profit of 30 percent?
e_en: Given: Buy 13 pens for 1 rupee, sell x pens for 1 rupee, profit = 30% Formula: Selling price = (100 + profit%)/cost price Solution: ⇒ Cost price per pen = 1/13 rupees, desired selling price per pen = 1/x rupees ⇒ Selling price = (100 + 30)/(1/13) = 10/13 rupees ⇒ 10/13 = 1/x ⇒ x = 13/10 = 10 pens Therefore, he should sell 10 pens for a rupee to earn a profit of 30 percent.

q_en: What will be the compound interest accrued on a sum of Rs. 64000 at the rate of 5% per annum in 2 years compounded annually?
e_en: Given: P = Rs. 64000 r = 5% per annum = 5/100 = 0.05 (in decimal) n = 1 (as the interest is compounded annually) t = 2 years Calculation: A = 64000(1 + 0.05/1)² = 64000(1.05)² = 64000 × 1.1025 = Rs. 70560 So, the total amount after 2 years would be Rs. 70560. Interest = A - P = 70560 - 64000 = Rs. 6560 Therefore, the compound interest accrued on a sum of Rs. 64000 at the rate of 5% per annum in 2 years, compounded annually, will be Rs. 6560.

q_en: If the third proportion of 3 and x is 27 and the third proportion of 2 and y is 8, then find x ∶ y.
e_en: Given: Third proportion of 3 and x is 27, third proportion of 2 and y is 8. Concept: The third proportion of a and b is given by (b²/a). Calculation: For 3 and x, we have x²/3 = 27 ⇒ x = √(27 × 3) ⇒ x = 9 For 2 and y, we have y²/2 = 8 ⇒ y = √(8 × 2) ⇒ y = 4 Therefore, the ratio x : y = 9 : 4.

q_en: Average marks obtained by 19 boys of a college is 48. If the highest marks and lowest marks obtained are removed, then the average marks reduces by 4. What is the average of the highest and lowest marks obtained?
e_en: Given: Average marks of 19 boys is 48. After removing highest and lowest marks, average of 17 boys is 44. Concept Average = Total Marks/Number of Students. Calculation: Total marks of 19 boys = 19 × 48 = 912 Total marks of 17 boys = 17 × 44 = 748 The sum of the highest and lowest marks = 912 - 748 = 164 The average of the highest and lowest marks = 164/2 = 82 Hence, the average of the highest and lowest marks is 82.

q_en: The price of a mobile is Rs. 30,000. The value of the mobile depreciates by 12% at the end of the first year and at the end of next year, it depreciates by 15%. What will be the value of the mobile after 2 years?
e_en: Given: Price of a mobile = Rs. 30,000. It depreciates by 12% at the end of the first year and 15% at the end of the second year. Concept: Depreciation is calculated by taking a certain percentage off the value at the start of each year. Calculation: After the first year, the value = 30,000 × (1 - 12/100) ⇒ Rs. 26,400 After the second year, the value = 26,400 × (1 - 15/100) ⇒ Rs. 22,440 Hence, the value of the mobile after 2 years is Rs. 22,440.

q_en: Tripti can construct a divider alone in 4 days while Rajan can construct it alone in 3 days. If they construct it together and get a payment of Rs. 14000, then what is Tripti's share?
e_en: Given: Tripti can construct a divider alone in 4 days, Rajan in 3 days. Total payment = Rs. 14,000. Concept: The share of each person is proportional to the amount of work they do. Calculation: Tripti's work rate = 1/4 per day Rajan's work rate = 1/3 per day Total work rate = 1/4 + 1/3 ⇒ 7/12 per day Therefore, Tripti's share = Rs. 14,000 × (1/4 ÷ 7/12) ⇒ Rs. 6,000 Hence, Tripti's share is Rs. 6,000.

q_en: P, Q and R alone can do a piece of work in 5, 6 and 4 days respectively. All three of them began the work together but Q left 1 days before completion of the work. In how many days was the work completed?

q_en: A man walking at the speed of 8 km/hr covers a certain distance in 5 hours and 30 minutes. If he covers the same distance by cycle in 4 hours, then what is the speed of cycle?
e_en: Given: Speed of walking = 8 km/hr Time taken to cover the distance = 5 hours 30 minutes Time taken by cycling the distance = 4 hours Formula used: Distance = Speed × Time Calculation: Let the distance covered by man be 'D'. ⇒ D = 8 × 5.5 = 44 km Speed while cycling = 44/4 = 11 km/hr The speed of the cycle is 11 km/hr.

q_en: A sum of Rs. 3000 becomes Rs. 4320 in 2 years at a certain rate of compound interest (compounding annually). How much this sum will become after 4 years?

According to the question, ⇒ 4320 = 3000 × (1 + r/100)² ⇒ (4320/3000) = (1 + r/100)² ⇒ (144/100) = (1 + r/100)² ⇒ 1 + r/100 = 12/10 ⇒ r = 2/10 × 100 = 20% After 2 more years, 4320 will become: ⇒ A = 4320 × (1 + 20/100)2 ⇒ A = 4320 × (6/5)² ⇒ A = 6220.8 ∴ In 4 years Rs. 3000 will amount to Rs. 6220.8 at 20% p.a. compound interest.

q_en: What is the HCF of 2.7 and 20.25?

q_en: In a field 8 workers complete a task in 22 days. If this task is to be completed in 44 days, then how many workers will be required?
e_en: Given: 8 workers complete a task in 22 days Concept used: M₁ × D₁ × H₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂ Where, M = Men ; D = day ; H = hour Calculation: M1 × D1 = M2 × D2 ⇒ 8 × 22 = M2 × 44 ⇒ M2 = (8 × 22)/44 ⇒ M₂ = 4 workers ∴ The correct answer is 4.

q_en: The product of LCM and HCF of two number is 2028. If one number is 78, then what is the other number?

q_en: A sum of Rs. 7500 amounts to Rs. 15000 in two years at compound interest calculated annually. How much will Rs. 7500 becomes in four years?
e_en: Given: Principal = Rs.7500 Time = 2 years Amount = Rs.15000 Formula used: (T₁)¹/ⁿ¹ = (T₂)¹/ⁿ² Calculation: In two years the principal becomes 2 times. So, ⇒ (2)⁽¹/²⁾ = (4)⁽¹/ⁿ⁾ ⇒ (2)(1/2) = (2)(2/n) base are the same then power must be equal. ⇒ (1/2) = (2/n) ⇒ n = 4 So, the principal becomes 4 times. ⇒ 7500 × 4 = Rs.30000 ∴ The correct answer is Rs.30000.

q_en: An article was sold at a loss of 14%. If it was sold for Rs. 756 more, then there would have been a gain of 7%. Find the cost price of the article.
e_en: Given: Loss% = 14% Formula used: Selling price (S.P) = Cost price (C.P) - {Cost price (C.P) × (100 ± P/L)%} Calculation: The article sold at a loss of 14%. C.P : S.P = 100 : 86 If the article will be sold at a profit of 7%. C.P : S.P = 100 : 107 Now, Difference of S.P = 756 ⇒ (107 - 86) units = 756 ⇒ 21 units = 756 ⇒ 1 unit = Rs.36 ⇒ 100 units = 36 × 100 = Rs.3600 ∴ The correct answer is Rs.3600.

q_en: A man buys 15 pens for a rupee. How many pens should he sell for a rupee to earn a profit of 50 percent?

q_en: P alone can do a piece of work in 24 days. Q alone can do it in 30 days and R alone can do it in 20 days. In how many days they can complete it together?
e_en: Given: Time taken by P alone = 24 days Time taken by Q alone = 30 days Time taken by R alone = 20 days Formula Used: Combined one-day work = Sum of each person's one-day work Total time to complete the work = 1/Combined one-day work Calculation: Combined work of P, Q, R = 1/24 + 1/30 + 1/20 = (5 + 4 + 6)/120 = 15/120 = 1/8 So, Total required time = 1/(1/8) = 8 Days ∴ P, Q, and R together can complete the work in 8 days.

q_en: What is the average of first five multiples of 11?

q_en: Walking at the speed of 5 kmph, a man covers a certain distance in 3 hours. Running at a speed of 15 kmph the man will cover the same distance in:
e_en: Given: Walking speed = 5 km/hr Time = 3 hr Running speed = 15 km/hr Formula used: Distance = Speed × Time Calculation: Total distance = 5 × 3 ⇒ 15 km Now if he covers this distance by running at a speed of 15 km /hr then, ⇒ 15 = 15 × time Time = 1 hour ∴ Man will cover same distance in 1 hour.

q_en: Rakesh incurs 4% loss by selling a TV for Rs. 39216. At what price should the TV be sold to earn 4% profit?
e_en: Given: Loss% = 4 and Selling price = 39216 Formula used: CP = ( SP × 100 )/(100 – percentage loss) Calculation: C.P = (39216 × 100) / (100 - 4) C.P = 3921600 / 96 C.P = 40850 Now to earn 4% profit: S.P = C.P × (100 + profit%) /100 S.P = 40850 × (100 + 4) /100 S.P = 4248400 / 100 S.P = 42484. ∴ TV should be sold at Rs. 42484.

q_en: Find the loss percentage if : Cost price = Rs. 4500 and Selling price = Rs. 3900
e_en: Given: Cost price = Rs. 4500 Selling price = Rs. 3900 Formula used: Loss% = (Loss/C.P) × 100 Calculation: Loss% = ((4500 - 3900) / 4500) × 100 Loss% = 600 / 4500 × 100 Loss% = 13.3% ∴ The loss% is 13.3%.

q_en: If a number A is 40 percent less than another number B and B is 20 percent more than 100, then what is the value of A?
e_en: Calculation: The number B = 100 + 100 × (20 / 100) ⇒ 100 + 20 = 120 The number A is 40% less than B, ⇒ A = 120 × (100 - 40)/100 ⇒ A = 72. ∴ The value of A is 72.

q_en: The students in three classes are in a ratio of 3 ∶ 7 ∶ 8. If 6 students are increased in each class, the ratio changes to 11 ∶ 23 ∶ 26. Find the total number of students in the three classes before the increase.

When the number of students is increased by 6 in each class, Then the number of students in three classes will be 3x + 6, 7x + 6 and 8x + 6 respectively.

q_en: If the diameter of a circle is 14 cm, find the area of the sector of the circle whose central angle measure 60 degree.

q_en: What is the value of 0.4 × 0.5 + 2 × (0.10 - 0.5)?
e_en: Given: Expression = 0.4 times 0.5 + 2 times (0.10 - 0.5) Formula used: BODMAS Rule (Brackets, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction) Calculations: 0.4 times 0.5 + 2 times (0.10 - 0.5) ⇒ 0.4 times 0.5 + 2 times (-0.4) ⇒ 0.2 + (-0.8) ⇒ 0.2 - 0.8 ⇒ -0.60 ∴ The correct answer is option (D).

q_en: A speeding car traveling at 40 km/hr decides to slow down to 30 km/hr after covering half the distance. What is the average speed?
e_en: Given: Car speed = 40 km/hr Car's speed after slowing down = 30 km/hr Formula used: Average speed = Total distance/total time Calculation: Let the total distance be 2x km Time is taken to cover half the distance at 40 km/hr = x / 40 hr Time is taken to cover rest half distance at 30 km/hr = x / 30 hr Total time taken = x / 40 + x / 30 ⇒ (3x + 4x) / 120 ⇒ 7x / 120 Average speed = 2x / (7x / 120) ⇒ 240/7 km/hr ∴ The average speed is 240/7 km/hr.

q_en: Sonam bought an old motor bike for Rs. 4675 and spent Rs. 225 on its repair. Then she sold it in Rs. 5390. What is her profit percent?
e_en: Given: Cost price (CP) of the motorbike = Rs. 4675 Expenses on repair = Rs. 225 Selling price (SP) of the motorbike = Rs. 5390 Formula: Profit percent = [(SP - CP - Repair expenses) / Total CP] × 100 Calculation: Profit percent = [(5390 - 4675 - 225) / (4675 + 225)] × 100 Profit percent = [(5390 - 4900) / 4900] × 100 Profit percent = (490 / 4900) × 100 Profit percent = 10% Sonam's profit percent on the motorbike is 10%.

q_en: Average price of 20 pens is Rs. 18. If 12 new pens are added, then the average price rise by Rs. 4. What is the total price of the new pens?
e_en: Given: Number of pens = 20 Average price of 20 pens = Rs. 18 Number of new pens added = 12 Increase in average price = Rs. 4 Formula: Total price of pens = Number of pens × Average price Calculation: Total price of 20 pens = 20 × 18 = Rs. 360 Total price of 32 pens (20 old + 12 new) = 32 × (18 + 4) = 32 × 22 = Rs. 704 Total price of new pens = Total price of 32 pens - Total price of 20 pens = Rs. 704 - Rs. 360 = Rs. 344 The total price of the new pens is Rs. 344.

q_en: A can do a piece of work in 16 days. B can do the same work in 24 days. A started the work alone. After how many days should B join him, so that the work is finished in 10 days?
e_en: Given: A can do the work in 16 days (A's work rate = 1/16) B can do the work in 24 days (B's work rate = 1/24) A starts the work alone. Let "x" be the number of days A works alone before B joins. In "x" days, A completes a fraction of the work equal to (x/16). When B joins, they work together for (10 - x) days to complete the remaining work. The combined work rate of A and B is (1/16 + 1/24) = (3/48 + 2/48) = 5/48.

q_en: A alone can do a piece of work in 30 days. He worked at it for 5 days and then B alone finished the remaining work in 10 days. In how many days B alone can finish the entire work?
e_en: Given: A's work rate = 1/30 (A can do the work in 30 days) A worked for 5 days B finished the remaining work in 10 days Formula: Work rate × Time = Work done (1 job) Calculation: Work done by A = (A's work rate) × (Time A worked) = (1/30) × 5 = 5/30 = 1/6 Now, the remaining work to be done when B takes over is 1 - 1/6 = 5/6.

q_en: What is the Least Common Multiple of lengths 80 cm, 90 cm and 112 cm?

q_en: The average of 15 numbers is 45. One more number is added, and the new average becomes 50. What is that new number?

q_en: If two successive discounts of 10 percent and 20 percent are offered, then what is the net discount?

q_en: A sum of Rs. 900 is divided into two parts such that the interest on the first part at 4% simple interest per annum and that on the other part at 2% simple interest per annum are equal. What is the interest accumulated on each part in a year?
e_en: Given:- Total sum = Rs. 900 Rate % on the 1st part = 4% Rate% on the 2nd part = 2% Formula Used:- S.I = PRT/100 Where, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time Calculation:- Let the two parts be x and (900 - x) According to the question S.I on the 1st part = S.I on the 2nd part ⇒ (x × 4 × 1)/100 = [(900 - x) × 2 × 1]/100 ⇒ 4x = 1800 - 2x ⇒ 6x = 1800 ⇒ x = 300 So, The interest on each part = 4x/100 ⇒ (4 × 300)/100 ⇒ 12 ∴ Simple interest on each part is Rs. 12.

q_en: The marked price of an article is 150 percent of the cost price. If 30 percent discount is given, then what will be the profit percentage?

q_en: Average of 4 numbers is 45. Average of first two numbers is thrice the average of other two numbers. What is the sum of first two numbers?
e_en: Given: The average of four numbers is 45 The average of the first two numbers is thrice the average of the other two numbers Concept used: Average × Number of entities = Total Calculation: Let the first two numbers be a and b and the last two be c and d. ⇒ (a + b)/2 = 3 × (c + d)/2 ⇒ (a + b) = 3 × (c + d) ⇒ a + b + c + d = 4 × 45 = 180 ⇒ a + b + (a + b)/3 = 180 ⇒ a + b (1 + 1/3) = 180 ⇒ a + b × 4/3 = 180 ⇒ a + b = 135 ∴ The answer is 135.

q_en: A sum of money at simple interest amounts to Rs. 212 in 2 years and to Rs. 224 in 4 years. The sum is:
e_en: Given: Amount in 2 years = Rs. 212 Amount in 4 years = Rs. 224 Formula Used: Amount = Principal + n(Simple Interest) (where n = no. of years) Calculation: Let the Principal be P Amount in 2 years = Rs. 212 ⇒ P + 2(S.I) = Rs. 212 ---(1) Amount in 4 years = Rs. 224 ⇒ P + 4(S.I) = Rs. 224 ---(2) Subtract (1) and (2) ⇒ S.I = Rs. 6 Put the value of S.I in eq (1) ⇒ P + 2(6) = Rs. 212 ⇒ P = Rs. 200 ∴ The required answer is Rs. 200

q_en: The average of 15 results is 52. If the average of first 8 results is 56 and that of the last 8 results is 55, then what will be the value of 8th result?
e_en: Given: The average of 15 results = 52 The average of first 8 results = 56 The average of last 8 results = 55 Formula used: The sum of N numbers = average of N number × N Calculation: Sum of 15 results = 52 × 15 = 780 Sum of the first 8 results = 56 × 8 = 448 Sum of the last 8 results = 55 × 8 = 440 The value of 8th result = (Sum of the first 8 results + Sum of the last 8 results) - Sum of 15 results ⇒ (448 + 440) - 780 ⇒ 888 - 780 = 108 ∴ The correct answer is 108.

Calculation: LCM of 14, 84 and 28 14 = 2 × 7 84 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7 28 = 2 × 2 × 7 LCM of 14, 84 and 28 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7 = 84 To make the number perfect square multiply by 3 and 7 in 84, then ⇒ 84 × 3 × 7 ⇒ 1764 ∴ The least number which is a perfect square and is divisible by each of the numbers 14, 84 and 28 is 1764.

q_en: What is the average of the first four multiples of 6?

q_en: What will be the HCF of the following set of numbers: 30, 45, 150, ?

Calculation: The factors of 30 are 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 30. The factors of 45 are 1, 3, 5, 9, 15, 45. The factors of 150 are 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 15, 25, 30, 50, 75, 150. The common factors of 30, 45, and 150 are 1, 3, 5, 15. HCF = 15 Therefore, the HCF of the numbers 30, 45, and 150 is 15.

q_en: Find compound interest on Rs. 8000 at 15% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually.
e_en: Given: Principal (P) = Rs. 8000 Rate of interest (R) = 15% per annum Time (T) = 2 years Formula: Compound Interest = P(1 + R/100)² - P Calculation: ⇒ Compound Interest = 8000(1 + 15/100)² - 8000 ⇒ Compound Interest = 8000(1.15)² - 8000 Compound Interest = Rs. 2580 Therefore, the compound interest on Rs. 8000 at 15% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually, is Rs. 2580.

q_en: Rs. 1800 is divided among A and B in the ratio of 2 ∶ 3 respectively. What is the share of A?

Calculation: ⇒ Total parts in the ratio = 2 + 3 = 5 ⇒ Each part = Total amount / Total parts in the ratio = 1800 / 5 ⇒ The share of A = 2 × Each part The share of A = Rs. 720 Therefore, the share of A is Rs. 720.

q_en: Manny bought an AC for Rs. 12000 and paid Rs. 400 for transportation. Then he sold it for Rs. 14000. Find his profit %.

q_en: What is that rate of simple interest at which a sum of money becomes three times of Itself in 36 years?
e_en: Given: Principal = P Amount = 3P Time = 36 years Concept used: Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100 Calculation: Simple interest (S.I) = Amount - Principal ⇒ S.I = 3P - P = 2P Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100 ⇒ 2P = (P × R × 36)/100 ⇒ R × 36 = 200 ⇒ R = 200/36 = 5.55% ∴ The correct answer is 5.55%.

q_en: A sum of Rs. 2600 is invested in a scheme of simple interest. It becomes Rs. 3320 in 3 years. How much this sum will become in 5 years?

q_en: The average height of P, Q and R is 160 cm. If the average height of P and Q is 140 cm and that of Q and R is 129 cm, then what is the height of Q?
e_en: Given:- The average height of P, Q, and R is 160 cm The average height of P and Q is 140 cm The average height of R and Q is 129 cm Formula used:- Average = Sum of Values/Number of Values Calculation:- ⇒ (P + Q + R)/3 = 160 ⇒ (P + Q + R) = 480 Similarly, ⇒ (P + Q)/2 = 140 ⇒ (P + Q) = 280 ⇒ R = (P + Q + R) - (P + Q) ⇒ R = 480 - 280 = 200 Similarly, ⇒ (Q + R)/2 = 129 ⇒ Q + R = 258 ⇒ Q = 258 - 200 = 58 cm ∴ The required answer is 58 cm.

The one-day work of Avi = {1over60} The one-day work of Prakash = {1over80} The one-day work of together = {1over X} ⇒ {1over X}={1over60}+{1over80} ⇒ {1over X}={4+3over240} ⇒ {1over X}={7over240} ⇒ X={240over7} ∴ The required result will be {240over7}.

q_en: What is that least perfect square, which is exactly divisible by each of 12, 84 and 24?
e_en: Given: Numbers are 12, 84, and 24. Formula: The least number which is exactly divisible by each one of the given numbers is called their LCM. Calculation: LCM of 12, 84 and 24 12 = 2 × 2 × 3 84 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7 24 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 LCM of 12, 84 and 24 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 7 = 168 To make the number perfect, multiply by 2, 3, and 7 in 168. Then, 168 x 2 x 3 x 7 = 7056 The least perfect square, divisible by each of 12, 84, and 24 is 7056.

q_en: If a loss is 1/8th of the selling price, then the loss percentage is:

q_en: What sum of money (in Rs.) will amount to Rs. 20,400 at the rate of 9% per annum simple interest in four years?
e_en: Given: Amount (A) = ₹20,400 Rate (r) = 9% per annum Time (t) = 4 years Formula used: A = P + (P × r × t) / 100 Where, P = Principal Calculation: 20,400 = P + (P × 9 × 4) / 100 ⇒ 20,400 = P + (36P) / 100 ⇒ 20,400 = P × (1 + 36/100) ⇒ 20,400 = P × 1.36 ⇒ P = 20,400 ÷ 1.36 ⇒ P = ₹15,000 ∴ The required sum of money is ₹15,000.

q_en: A medical store owner purchased medicines worth Rs. 18,000 from a company. He sold 2/5 part of the medicine at a 35% loss. On which gain, he should sell the rest of the medicines so that he has neither gain nor loss?

Loss = 35% Part sold at loss = 2/5 Part remaining = 1 - 2/5 = 3/5 Total cost price = Total selling price for no loss no gain condition. Calculation: Cost price of 2/5 part = (2/5) × 18000 = Rs. 7200 Loss on this part = 35% of 7200 = (35/100) × 7200 = Rs. 2520 Selling price of this part = 7200 - 2520 = Rs.

q_en: Three years ago, the value of car was Rs. 2,50,000. If the value depreciates by 6% every year, its value now is:
e_en: Given: Initial value of the car = Rs. 2,50,000. Depreciation rate = 6% per annum. Time = 3 years. Formula Used: Value after n years = Initial value × (1 - depreciation rate)ⁿ Calculation: Depreciation rate = 6% = 0.06 Value after 3 years = 2,50,000 × (1 - 0.06)³ ⇒ Value after 3 years = 2,50,000 × (0.94)³ ⇒ Value after 3 years = 2,50,000 × 0.830584 ⇒ Value after 3 years = Rs. 2,07,646 The value of the car now is Rs. 2,07,646.

q_en: A person crosses a 750 m long street in 5 minutes. Find his speed in km/h.
e_en: Given: Length of the street = 750 m Time taken to cross = 5 minutes Formula Used: Speed = Distance / Time 1 km = 1000 m 1 hour = 60 minutes Calculation: First, convert distance into km and time into hours. Distance = 750 m = 750 / 1000 km = 0.75 km Time = 5 minutes = 5 / 60 hours ⇒ Speed = 0.75 km / (5 / 60) hours ⇒ Speed = 0.75 × (60 / 5) km/h ⇒ Speed = 0.75 × 12 km/h ⇒ Speed = 9 km/h The speed of the person is 9 km/h.

q_en: While calculating the average marks of a class, the score increased by 0.5 when marks of one student is wrongly entered as 54 instead of 45. The number of students in the class is:
e_en: Given: The score increased by 0.5 when marks of one student are wrongly entered as 54 instead of 45. Formula Used: Error in total marks = Wrong entry - Correct entry Change in average = Error in total marks / Number of students Calculation: Error in total marks = 54 - 45 = 9 Change in average = 0.5 Let the number of students in the class be n. ⇒ 0.5 = 9 / n ⇒ n = 9 / 0.5 ⇒ n = 18 The number of students in the class is 18.

q_en: If a person walks at 18 km/hr instead of 12 km/hr, he would have walked 24 km more. What is the actual distance travelled by him?
e_en: Given: Speed at first = 18 km/hr. Speed at second = 12 km/hr. Extra distance covered = 24 km. Formula Used: Distance = Speed × Time Let the actual time taken to travel the distance at 12 km/hr be t hours. Calculation: Distance covered at 18 km/hr = 18t Distance covered at 12 km/hr = 12t According to the question, 18t = 12t + 24 ⇒ 6t = 24 ⇒ t = 4 hours Actual distance travelled = 12 × t = 12 × 4 = 48 km The actual distance travelled by him is 48 km.

q_en: Find the smallest three digit number which when added to 5 is exactly divisible by 12, 14 and 18.
e_en: Given: The number needs to be divisible by 12, 14, and 18 after adding 5 to it. Formula Used: LCM (Least Common Multiple) for finding a number divisible by all given numbers. Calculation: First, find the LCM of 12, 14, and 18. Prime factors are: 12 = 2² × 3 14 = 2 × 7 18 = 2 × 3² LCM = 2² × 3² × 7 = 4 × 9 × 7 = 252 So, the number must be divisible by 252. For the smallest three-digit number, add 5 to the number and check for divisibility by 252. ⇒ Let the number be N.

q_en: The height of a right circular cone is 20 cm, and its base diameter is 30 cm. What is the curved surface area and the total surface area of the right circular cone, respectively?
e_en: Given: Height (h) of the cone = 20 cm. Diameter of the base (d) = 30 cm. Radius (r) = d/2 = 30/2 = 15 cm. Formula Used: Slant height (l) of the cone = √(r² + h²). Curved surface area (CSA) of the cone = πrl. Total surface area (TSA) of the cone = πr(r + l). Calculation: First, calculate the slant height (l). l = √(r² + h²) ⇒ l = √(15² + 20²) ⇒ l = √(225 + 400) ⇒ l = √625 ⇒ l = 25 cm Now, calculate the curved surface area (CSA).

q_en: A thief is spotted by a policeman from a distance of 250 m. When the policeman starts chase, the thief also starts running. Assuming that the speed of the thief is 10 km/h and that of the policeman is 12.5 km/h. How far will have the thief run before he is caught?
e_en: Given: Distance between the policeman and the thief = 250 m. Speed of the thief = 10 km/h. Speed of the policeman = 12.5 km/h. Formula Used: Relative speed = Speed of the policeman - Speed of the thief. Time = Distance / Speed. Calculation: First, convert speeds into m/s: Speed of the thief = 10 × (1000/3600) = 10000/3600 m/s. Speed of the policeman = 12.5 × (1000/3600) = 12500/3600 m/s. Relative speed = (12500/3600) - (10000/3600) m/s. Relative speed = 2500/3600 m/s.

q_en: Three numbers are in the ratio 1 ∶ 2 ∶ 3. By adding 5 to each of the numbers then the ratio changes to 2 ∶ 3 ∶ 4. The smallest number is:
e_en: Given: Initial ratio of three numbers = 1:2:3. After adding 5 to each number, the new ratio = 2:3:4. Formula Used: Let the three numbers be x, 2x, and 3x respectively. After adding 5 to each, the numbers become (x + 5), (2x + 5), and (3x + 5). The new ratio is given by (x + 5):(2x + 5):(3x + 5) = 2:3:4. Calculation: Let the smallest number be x. Thus, the numbers are x, 2x, and 3x. After adding 5 to each, they become (x + 5), (2x + 5), and (3x + 5). The new ratio is 2:3:4.

Formula Used: Distance = Speed × Time New speed = Original speed + Increase in speed New time = Original time - Time saved Calculation: Distance = 60 kmph × 9 hours = 540 km To save 1 hour, new time = 9 hours - 1 hour = 8 hours Using Distance = New speed × New time ⇒ 540 = New speed × 8 ⇒ New speed = 540 / 8 = 67.5 kmph ⇒ Increase in speed = New speed - Original speed…

q_en: A man decided to cover 7.5 km in 72 minutes. He decided to cover two thirds of the distance at 5 km/h and the remaining at some different speed. Find the speed after two third distance has been covered.
e_en: Given: Total distance = 7.5 km. Time to cover the total distance = 72 minutes = 1.2 hours (since 72/60 = 1.2). Speed for two thirds of the distance = 5 km/h. Formula Used: Speed = Distance / Time Calculation: Distance for two thirds = (2/3) × 7.5 km = 5 km. Remaining distance = 7.5 km - 5 km = 2.5 km. Time taken to cover two thirds of the distance = 5 km / 5 km/h = 1 hour. Time left for the remaining distance = 1.2 hours - 1 hour = 0.2 hours.

q_en: If the diameter of a solid sphere is 42 cm, then the surface area of the sphere is: (use π = 22/7)
e_en: Given: Diameter of the solid sphere = 42 cm π = ²²/₇ Concept: The surface area of a sphere is given by the formula: Surface Area = 4πr² Formula Used: r = Diameter / 2 Surface Area = 4πr² Calculation: We have, ⇒ Diameter = 42 cm ⇒ Radius (r) = 42 / 2 = 21 cm ⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × r² ⇒ Surface Area = 4 × ²²/₇ × 21² ⇒ Surface Area = 4 × ²²/₇ × 441 ⇒ Surface Area = 4 × 22 × 63 ⇒ Surface Area = 5544 cm² ∴ The surface area of the sphere is 5544 cm².

q_en: When x = 1 and y = 8, y is directly proportional to x + 3. When z = 6 and x = 2, x is inversely proportional to z. Find the relation between y and z.
e_en: Calculation: Given that, y = k(x + 3) ----(1) When x = 1 ⇒ y = 8 ⇒ 8 = k(1 + 3) ⇒ 8 = 4k ⇒ k = 2 When z = 6 ⇒ x = 2 ⇒ x = k'/z ----(2) ⇒ 2 = k'/6 ⇒ k' = 12 From equation (1) & (2) ⇒ y = k[(k'/z) + 3] ⇒ y = 2[(12/z) + 3] ⇒ y = 24/z + 6 ⇒ y - 6 = 24/z ⇒ z(y - 6) = 24 ∴ Correct answer is z(y - 6) = 24

q_en: Find the simple interest on Rs. 8,000 at the rate of 10% per annum in 6 years.

q_en: Neha walks at the rate of 8 km/h and crosses a bridge in 27 minutes. What is the length of the bridge in metres?

Formula Used: Distance = Speed × Time Calculation: Time = 27/60 hours = 0.45 hours Distance (Length of the bridge) = Speed × Time ⇒ Distance = 8 km/h × 0.45 h ⇒ Distance = 3.6 km ⇒ Distance in metres = 3.6 × 1000 = 3600 metres The length of the bridge is 3600 metres.

q_en: Sanjay wants to exactly measure the lengths 7000 mm, 3850 mm and 12950 mm using a single measuring tape. What will be the greatest possible length (in cm) of the measuring tape?
e_en: Given: Lengths to be measured are 7000 mm, 3850 mm, and 12950 mm. Formula Used: To find the greatest possible length of the measuring tape that can measure the given lengths exactly, we need to calculate the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) of the lengths. Calculation: First, convert the lengths into the same unit. 7000 mm = 700 cm, 3850 mm = 385 cm, 12950 mm = 1295 cm. Now, calculate the GCD of 700, 385, and 1295.

q_en: 5 pipes are required to fill a tank in 1 hour and 40 minutes. How long (in minutes) will it take to fill the same tank if 4 pipes of the same type are used?
e_en: Given: 5 pipes fill a tank in 1 hour and 40 minutes (100 minutes). Formula Used: Time × Number of pipes = Constant (Work done) Calculation: Let the time taken by 4 pipes to fill the tank be T minutes. ⇒ 5 × 100 = 4 × T ⇒ T = (5 × 100) / 4 ⇒ T = 500 / 4 ⇒ T = 125 minutes It will take 125 minutes for 4 pipes to fill the tank.

q_en: The mean of 23 observations is 36. If the mean of the first 12 observations is 32 and that of the last 12 observations is 39, find the 12th observation.
e_en: Given: Total number of observations = 23 Mean of all observations = 36 Mean of the first 12 observations = 32 Mean of the last 12 observations = 39 Formula Used: Total sum of observations = Mean × Number of observations Calculation: Total sum of all observations = 36 × 23 Total sum of the first 12 observations = 32 × 12 Total sum of the last 12 observations = 39 × 12 Let the 12th observation be x.

q_en: By investing ₹12,000 in a scheme, R gets ₹15,500 back in return. What is his percentage of profit?
e_en: Given: Investment = ₹12,000 Return = ₹15,500 Formula Used: Profit % = (Profit / Investment) × 100 Calculation: Profit = Return - Investment ⇒ Profit = ₹15,500 - ₹12,000 ⇒ Profit = ₹3,500 Profit % = (₹3,500 / ₹12,000) × 100 ⇒ Profit % = 0.2917 × 100 ⇒ Profit % = 29.17% The percentage of profit is 29.17%.

q_en: If the income of T is 8 times his savings, then his expenditure is ___________ times his savings.
e_en: Given: Income of T = 8 × Savings. Formula Used: Income = Expenditure + Savings Calculation: Let the savings of T be x. ⇒ Income of T = 8x ⇒ Expenditure = Income - Savings ⇒ Expenditure = 8x - x ⇒ Expenditure = 7x The expenditure is 7 times his savings.

q_en: By selling a cycle for Rs. 5,800, a man gains 45%. What will be the cost price of the cycle?
e_en: Given: Selling Price (S.P) = Rs. 5,800 Profit = 45% Formula Used: Cost Price (C.P) = Selling Price (S.P) / (1 + Profit%) Calculation: ⇒ C.P = 5,800 / (1 + 45/100) ⇒ C.P = 5,800 / (1 + 0.45) ⇒ C.P = 5,800 / 1.45 ⇒ C.P = Rs. 4,000 The cost price of the cycle is Rs. 4,000.

q_en: A motorboat can row 12 km/h in still water. If the speed of the current is 2 km/h, it takes 1.5 hours more in covering some distance upstream than it does downstream for covering the same distance. The one-side distance is:
e_en: Given: Speed of the motorboat in still water = 12 km/h. Speed of the current = 2 km/h. Formula Used: Speed upstream = Speed in still water - Speed of the current. Speed downstream = Speed in still water + Speed of the current. Time = Distance / Speed. Let the one-side distance be x km. Calculation: Speed upstream = 12 - 2 = 10 km/h. Speed downstream = 12 + 2 = 14 km/h. Time upstream = x / 10. Time downstream = x / 14. Given, time upstream - time downstream = 1.5 hours.

q_en: Three numbers are in the ratio 5 ∶ 2 ∶ 7. The sum of their squares is 3822. The biggest number is:
e_en: Given: Ratio of three numbers = 5: 2: 7 Sum of their squares = 3822 Formula Used: If numbers are in the ratio a: b: c, then the numbers are ax, bx, cx. Here, x is the common multiplier. Calculation: Let the numbers be 5x, 2x, and 7x. Sum of their squares = (5x)² + (2x)² + (7x)² = 3822 ⇒ 25x² + 4x² + 49x² = 3822 ⇒ 78x² = 3822 ⇒ x² = 3822/78 ⇒ x2 = 49 ⇒ x = 7 The biggest number is 7x. ⇒ 7x = 7 × 7 = 49 The biggest number is 49.

q_en: The price of a commodity increased from Rs. 200 to Rs. 250. What is the percentage increase in price?
e_en: Given: Original price of the commodity = Rs. 200. New price of the commodity = Rs. 250. Formula Used: Percentage increase = [(New Price - Original Price) / Original Price] × 100 Calculation: ⇒ Percentage increase = [(250 - 200) / 200] × 100 ⇒ Percentage increase = (50 / 200) × 100 ⇒ Percentage increase = 0.25 × 100 ⇒ 25% The percentage increase in price is 25%.

q_en: A and B can do a piece of work in 6 and 12 days. respectively. If they work alternately and A begins the work. in how many days will the work be completed?

Formula Used: Work done by A in 1 day = 1/6 Work done by B in 1 day = 1/12 Calculation: Together in two days (A and B working alternately), work done = 1/6 + 1/12 ⇒ Work done in two days = (2 + 1)/12 ⇒ Work done in two days = 3/12 = 1/4 So, in 8 days (4 pairs of two days), work done = 4 × (1/4) = 1 Hence, the work will be completed in 8 days. q_en: Find the HCF of 230, 276, and 322.
e_en: Given: The numbers are 230, 276, and 322. Formula Used: HCF (Highest Common Factor) of given numbers. Calculation: First, we find the differences between the numbers: 276 - 230 = 46 322 - 276 = 46 ⇒ All differences = 46 Now, we find the factors of 46: ⇒ 1, 2, 23, 46 Since 46 is the largest factor common in all differences, and since 46 divides each of the given numbers without any remainder, it is the HCF of 230, 276, and 322. The HCF of 230, 276, and 322 is 46.

q_en: What is the total surface area (in cm²) of a right circular cone of radius 10.5 cm and slant height 13 cm? Take π = 22/7
e_en: Given: Radius of the cone = 10.5 cm. Slant height of the cone = 13 cm. Formula Used: Total Surface Area of a cone = πr(r + l), where r is the radius and l is the slant height. q_en: The mean proportion between 17 and some unknown number is 51. What is the unknown number?
e_en: Formula Used: Mean Proportion = √(a × b) Calculation: We have, ⇒ Mean Proportion = 51 ⇒ a = 17 Let the unknown number be b. ⇒ √(17 × b) = 51 Squaring both sides, ⇒ 17 × b = 51² ⇒ 17 × b = 2601 Dividing both sides by 17, ⇒ b = 2601 / 17 ⇒ b = 153 ∴ The unknown number is 153.

q_en: The marks scored by a student are directly proportional to the time invested in studies. If the student gets 60 marks when he studies 4 hours a day, then how many hours he should use in his studies daily to get 75 marks?
e_en: Given: Marks scored with 4 hours of study = 60 marks. Formula Used: Since marks are directly proportional to the time invested in studies, Marks = k × Time, where k is the proportionality constant. Calculation: 60 = k × 4 ⇒ k = 60 / 4 ⇒ k = 15 To get 75 marks, 75 = 15 × Time ⇒ Time = 75 / 15 ⇒ Time = 5 hours Therefore, the student should study 5 hours daily to get 75 marks.

q_en: The cost price of an item is Rs. 4,850. What is the profit percentage (rounded off to 1 decimal place) if it is sold at Rs. 6,680?

e_en: Formula Used: V = 4/3 pi r³ d = 2r (where d is the diameter) Calculation: ⇒ Volume of the sphere, V = 381 6/7 m³ ⇒ 381 6/7 = 381 + 6/7 = (2673 + 6)/(7) = 2679/7 = 382.71 m³ ⇒ Using V = 4/3 pi r³ ⇒ 382.71 = 4/3 pi r³ ⇒ r³ = (382.71 times 3)/(4 pi) ⇒ r³ = (1148.13)/(4 times 3.14) ⇒ r³ = (1148.13)/(12.56) = 91.43 ⇒ r = sqrt[3]{91.43} approx 4.5 {m} ⇒ Diameter, d = 2r = 2 times 4.5 = 9 m ∴ The diameter of the sphere is 9 m.

q_en: Ram purchased a TV for Rs. 65,500 and sold it for Rs. 89,080. What is the percentage profit he made on the TV?
e_en: Given: Cost Price of the TV = Rs. 65,500. Selling Price of the TV = Rs. 89,080. Formula Used: Percentage Profit = [(Selling Price - Cost Price) / Cost Price] × 100 Calculation: Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price ⇒ Profit = 89,080 - 65,500 ⇒ Profit = 23,580 Percentage Profit = (23,580 / 65,500) × 100 Percentage Profit = (23580 / 65500) × 100 Percentage Profit = 0.36 × 100 Percentage Profit = 36% Ram made a profit of 36% on the TV.

q_en: The simple interest on a sum of money is four times the principal. The rate per cent per annum and time in years are equal. Find the rate per cent per annum.
e_en: Given: Simple Interest (SI) = 4 × Principal (P) Rate per cent per annum (R) = Time in years (T) Formula Used: Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100 Calculation: Given SI = 4P, ⇒ (P × R × T) / 100 = 4P Given R = T, ⇒ (P × R × R) / 100 = 4P ⇒ R² = 400 ⇒ R = 20 The rate per cent per annum is 20% or 0.2.

q_en: The falling height of an object is directly proportional to the square of the time. An object falls 80 cm in 4 seconds. Then in 8 seconds, from how much height (in cm) will the object fall?

New income = ₹27,000 + 28% of ₹27,000 ⇒ ₹27,000 + (28/100) × ₹27,000 ⇒ ₹27,000 + ₹7,560 ⇒ ₹34,560.

q_en: Two trains having the same speed are running in opposite directions. If the length of each train is 120 metres and they cross each other in 8 seconds, then, what is the speed of each train (in km/h)?
e_en: Given: Length of each train = 120 metres. Time taken to cross each other = 8 seconds. Formula Used: Speed = Distance / Time Calculation: Total distance covered = Length of first train + Length of second train Total distance covered = 120 metres + 120 metres = 240 metres Time = 8 seconds ⇒ Speed = 240 metres / 8 seconds = 30 m/s To convert m/s into km/h, multiply by 18/5 ⇒ Speed in km/h = 30 × (18/5) = 108 km/h ⇒Speed of each train in km/h=108/2= 54 km/h.

q_en: The sum of the two numbers is the same as nine times their difference. The ratio of the numbers is:
e_en: Given: The sum of the two numbers is the same as nine times their difference. Formula Used: Let the two numbers be x and y. Sum of the numbers = x + y Difference of the numbers = |x - y| Sum = 9 × Difference Calculation: ⇒ x + y = 9(x - y) Let's assume x > y, so the difference x - y is positive. ⇒ x + y = 9x - 9y Bringing like terms to one side, ⇒ 9y + y = 9x - x ⇒ 10y = 8x Dividing both sides by 8y, ⇒ x/y = 10/8 ⇒ x/y = 5/4 Therefore, the ratio of the numbers is 5 : 4.

q_en: What is the average of the first 13 multiples of 3?

q_en: The ratio of principal and amount is 5 ∶ 6 for one year. Find the rate of simple interest per annum?
e_en: Given: The ratio of principal to amount for one year = 5:6. Formula Used: Simple Interest = Amount - Principal Rate of Simple Interest = (Simple Interest × 100) / (Principal × Time) Calculation: Let the principal be 5x and the amount be 6x. ⇒ Simple Interest = Amount - Principal = 6x - 5x = x Time = 1 year ⇒ Rate of Simple Interest = (x × 100) / (5x × 1) ⇒ Rate of Simple Interest = 100 / 5 ⇒ Rate of Simple Interest = 20% The rate of simple interest per annum is 0.2 or 20%.

q_en: A boat man goes 6 km against the current of the stream in 2 hours and goes 1.5 km along the current in 7.5 minutes. How long will (in hours) it take to go 30 km in still water?
e_en: Given: Distance against the current = 6 km, Time taken = 2 hours. Distance along the current = 1.5 km, Time taken = 7.5 minutes = 7.5/60 hours. Formula Used: Speed = Distance / Time Speed in still water = (Speed downstream + Speed upstream) / 2 Time = Distance / Speed Calculation: Speed upstream = 6 / 2 = 3 km/hr. Speed downstream = 1.5 / (7.5/60) = 1.5 / (1/8) = 12 km/hr. Speed in still water = (3 + 12) / 2 = 15 / 2 = 7.5 km/hr.

q_en: The difference between the compound interest (Compounded annually) and simple interest for an amount of Rs. 85,000 in 2 years is Rs. 850. Find the rate of Interest per annum.
e_en: Given: Principal (P) = Rs. 85,000 Time (T) = 2 years Difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest = Rs. 850 Formula Used: Difference = P × (R/100)² when T = 2 years Calculation: 850 = 85000 × (R/100)² ⇒ 850 = 850 × R² / 100 ⇒ R² = 100 ⇒ R = 10 The rate of Interest per annum is 10%.

q_en: A store sells an item for Rs. 500, making a profit of 25%. Later, the store reduces the price of the item by 20% to clear out old inventory. What is the new percentage profit or loss for the store?
e_en: Given: Original selling price = Rs. 500 Profit = 25% Price reduced by = 20% Formula Used: Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price (SP) / (1 + Profit%) New Selling Price = Original SP × (1 - Reduction%) Profit or Loss% = [(New SP - CP) / CP] × 100 Calculation: CP = 500 / (1 + 25/100) CP = 500 / 1.25 CP = 400 New SP = 500 × (1 - 20/100) New SP = 500 × 0.8 New SP = 400 Profit or Loss% = [(400 - 400) / 400] × 100 Profit or Loss% = 0% There is no profit, no loss for the store.

q_en: A dishonest merchant sells his grocery using weights that are 15% less than the true weights and makes a profit of 20%. Find his total gain percentage.
e_en: Given: The merchant uses weights that are 15% less than the true weight. The merchant makes a profit of 20% on the sale. Formula Used: Total Gain Percentage = [(Gain due to weight difference) + Profit] + [(Gain due to weight difference) × Profit] Calculation: Let the true weight = 100 units. The weight used by the merchant = 100 - 15% of 100 = 100 - 15 = 85 units.

q_en: Sandeep sold an overcoat for ₹8,784 and made a profit of 22%. Determine the original cost of the overcoat.

q_en: A train travelling at a speed of 36 km/h crosses a pole in 24 sec. What is the length of the train?
e_en: Given: Speed of the train = 36 km/h Time taken to cross the pole = 24 seconds Formula Used: Length of the train = Speed × Time Calculation: Convert speed to m/s: Speed = 36 km/h = (36 × 1000) / (60 × 60) m/s ⇒ Speed = 10 m/s Calculate the length of the train: Length = Speed × Time ⇒ Length = 10 × 24 ⇒ Length = 240 m The length of the train is 240 meters.

q_en: The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 11 and 3465, respectively. If one of the two numbers is 693, what is the other number?

First number × Second number = Product of two numbers ⇒ 693 × x = 38115 ⇒ x = 38115 / 693 ⇒ x = 55 The other number is 55.

q_en: Two trains are running in opposite directions at the same speed. If the length of each train is 150 m and they cross each other in 15 sec, find the speed of each train (in km/hr).
e_en: Given: Length of each train = 150 m Time taken to cross each other = 15 sec Formula Used: Relative Speed = (Sum of the lengths of trains) / Time taken Speed of each train = Relative Speed / 2 1 m/s = 18/5 km/hr Calculation: Sum of the lengths of the trains = 150 + 150 = 300 m Relative Speed = 300 / 15 = 20 m/s Speed of each train = 20 / 2 ⇒ Speed of each train = 10 m/s Speed in km/hr = 10 × 18/5 ⇒ Speed in km/hr = 36 km/hr Speed of each train is 36 km/hr.

q_en: If 80 workers took 25 days to finish a task, how many days will it take to finish the same task if 20 more workers join?
e_en: Given: Number of workers initially = 80 Number of days taken initially = 25 Number of workers after 20 join = 80 + 20 = 100 Formula Used: Work = Total workers × Days Calculation: Work done by 80 workers in 25 days = 80 × 25 Work done = 2000 units Let the number of days taken by 100 workers be x. Work done by 100 workers in x days = 100 × x Equating the work: ⇒ 100 × x = 2000 ⇒ x = 2000 / 100 ⇒ x = 20 days The correct answer is option D (20 days).

q_en: If Mohan's income is 20% less than Arvind's income, then how much per cent is Arvind's income more than Mohan's income?
e_en: Given: Mohan's income is 20% less than Arvind's income. Formula Used: If one value is x% less than another, the other value is ((x)/(100-x)) × 100 % more. Calculation: Let Arvind's income be 100. Then Mohan's income = 100 - 20 = 80. Arvind's income is more than Mohan's income by: ⇒ ((100 - 80)/(80)) × 100 ⇒ (20/80) × 100 ⇒ 0.25 × 100 ⇒ 25% Arvind's income is 25% more than Mohan's income. The correct answer is option D.

q_en: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 6% per year rate of interest for 2 years.

q_en: The marks obtained by A in Mathematics, English and Biology are 71 out of 100, 82 out of 150 and 177 out of 200, respectively. What is the average score?
e_en: Given: Marks obtained by A in Mathematics = 71 out of 100. Marks obtained by A in English = 82 out of 150. Marks obtained by A in Biology = 177 out of 200. Formula Used: Average score = (Sum of marks obtained in all subjects) / (Sum of total marks of all subjects). Calculation: Sum of marks obtained = 71 + 82 + 177 = 330. Sum of total marks = 100 + 150 + 200 = 450. Average score = (330 / 450). ⇒ Average score = (11 / 15). The average score is (11 / 15).

(x + x²) ÷ 2 = 7x ⇒ x + x² = 14x ⇒ x² + x - 14x = 0 ⇒ x² - 13x = 0 ⇒ x(x - 13) = 0 ⇒ x = 0 or x = 13 Since the number is non-zero, x = 13. ∴ The correct answer is option (D).

q_en: The ratio of two numbers is 3:4 and their HCF is 4. Then, their LCM is:
e_en: Given: The ratio of two numbers = 3:4 The HCF of the two numbers = 4 Formula used: LCM × HCF = Product of the numbers If the numbers are in the ratio a:b, then the numbers can be written as: First number = a × HCF Second number = b × HCF LCM = Product of the numbers / HCF Calculation: First number = 3 × 4 = 12 Second number = 4 × 4 = 16 Product of the numbers = 12 × 16 = 192 ⇒ LCM = 192 / 4 ⇒ LCM = 48 ∴ The correct answer is option (D).

q_en: By selling an article for ₹20, a dealer makes a profit of 10%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹, rounded off to two decimal place) so as to make a profit of 50%?

q_en: Find the HCF of 70 and 90.
e_en: Given: Numbers to find HCF: 70 and 90. Formula Used: HCF is found by the method of prime factorization. Calculation: Prime factorization of 70: 70 = 2 × 5 × 7 Prime factorization of 90: 90 = 2 × 3² × 5 Common prime factors: 2, 5 HCF = 2 × 5 ⇒ HCF = 10 The HCF of 70 and 90 is 10.

q_en: Rakesh rented out an amount to Samarth for 6 years at simple interest rate. At the end of the 6th year, Samarth paid 8/7 of the amount to Rakesh to clear out the amount. The rate of simple interest per annum was:
e_en: Given: Time (t) = 6 years Amount paid by Samarth = 8/7 of the principal Formula Used: Simple Interest (SI) = (P times R times T)/(100) Total amount (A) = Principal (P) + SI Calculation: According to the question: ⇒ A = 8/7 P ⇒ P + (P times R times 6)/(100) = 8/7 P Dividing both sides by P: ⇒ 1 + (6R)/(100) = 8/7 Solving for R: ⇒ (6R)/(100) = 8/7 - 1 ⇒ (6R)/(100) = 1/7 ⇒ 6R = 100/7 ⇒ R = 100/42 ⇒ R = 2.38% = 2 8/21% ∴ The rate of simple interest per annum was 2 8/21%.

q_en: A person sold an article and got a loss of 9%. If he sold it for ₹51 more he would gain 8%. Find the C.P
e_en: Given: A person sold an article and got a loss of 9%. If he sold it for ₹51 more, he would gain 8%. Calculations: Let the Cost Price (C.P) be x. Selling Price (S.P) at 9% loss = x - 0.09x = 0.91x Selling Price (S.P) at 8% gain = x + 0.08x = 1.08x According to the question: 1.08x - 0.91x = 51 1.08x - 0.91x = 51 0.17x = 51 x = 51 / 0.17 x = 300 ∴ The Cost Price (C.P) is ₹300.

q_en: A cyclist covers a distance of 2.5 km in 4 minutes 10 seconds. How long will he take to cover a distance of 6 km at the same speed?
e_en: Given: Distance covered = 2.5 km Time taken = 4 minutes 10 seconds = 4 + 10/60 = 4 + 1/6 = 25/6 minutes New distance = 6 km Formula Used: Time = Distance / Speed Calculation: Speed = Distance / Time Speed = 2.5 / (25/6) Speed = 2.5 × 6 / 25 Speed = 15 / 25 Speed = 3 / 5 km/min Time to cover 6 km = Distance / Speed Time to cover 6 km = 6 / (3/5) Time to cover 6 km = 6 × 5 / 3 Time to cover 6 km = 30 / 3 Time to cover 6 km = 10 minutes Therefore, the correct answer is option D.

q_en: In 2016, the price of a refrigerator increased by 5%, and in 2017, it decreased by 5%. At the end of the year 2017, its price was ₹47,880. What was its price at the beginning of the year 2016?
e_en: Given: Price at the end of 2017 = ₹47,880 Price increase in 2016 = 5% Price decrease in 2017 = 5% Calculation: Let the price at the beginning of 2016 be ₹P. Price after 5% increase in 2016 = P × 1.05 Price after 5% decrease in 2017 = (P × 1.05) × 0.95 Given that the price at the end of 2017 is ₹47,880: (P × 1.05) × 0.95 = 47,880 ⇒ P × 1.05 × 0.95 = 47,880 ⇒ P × 0.9975 = 47,880 ⇒ P = 47,880 / 0.9975 ⇒ P = 48,000 ∴ The price at the beginning of the year 2016 was ₹48,000.

q_en: There are 20 cricket balls in the showroom. Among these 20 balls, some are yellow and some are white. The average cost of all the balls is ₹75. If the average cost of yellow balls is ₹80 and that of white is ₹60, then the number of yellow balls is:

q_en: A dishonest shopkeeper promises to sell his goods at cost price. However, he uses a weight that actually weighs 33% less than what is written on it. Find his profit percentage.
e_en: Given: A dishonest shopkeeper uses a weight that weighs 33% less than what is written on it. He promises to sell at cost price. Formula used: Profit Percentage = (True Value - Cost Price / Cost Price) × 100 Calculation: True Weight = (1 - 33/100) × Written Weight True Weight = 67% of Written Weight Suppose the cost price of 1 kg is ₹100 (for simplicity).

q_en: How long (in years) will it take for a sum of money invested at 4% per annum on simple interest to increase its value by 30%?
e_en: Given: Rate (r) = 4% per annum Increase in value = 30% Formula used: Simple Interest (SI) = (P × r × t) / 100 Where, SI = Increase in value Calculation: Let Principal (P) be ₹100 (assumed for simplicity) Increase in value = 30% of ₹100 = ₹30 ⇒ SI = ₹30 ⇒ ₹30 = (₹100 × 4 × t) / 100 ⇒ 30 = (400 × t) / 100 ⇒ t = (30 × 100) / 400 ⇒ t = 7.5 years or 7 1/2 years ∴ The correct answer is option (A).

q_en: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 4% per year rate of interest for 6 years.
e_en: Given: Principal (P) = ₹2500 Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per year Time (T) = 6 years Formula used: Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T)/(100) Calculation: {SI} = (2500 × 4 × 6)/(100) ⇒ SI = 60000/100 ⇒ SI = ₹600 ∴ The correct answer is option (B).

q_en: A quadrilateral ABCD has sides AB = 5 units, BC = 12 units, CD = DA and ∠ABC = ∠ADC = 90°. What is the area of the quadrilateral (in square units)?
e_en: Given: A quadrilateral ABCD has sides AB = 5 units, BC = 12 units, CD = DA, and ∠ABC = ∠ADC = 90º. Formula used: Area of quadrilateral = Area of triangle ABC + Area of triangle ADC Area of a right triangle = (1/2) × Base × Height Calculation: In triangle ABC: Base = AB = 5 units, Height = BC = 12 units ⇒ Area of triangle ABC = (1/2) × 5 × 12 ⇒ Area of triangle ABC = 30 square units In triangle ADC: Since CD = DA, triangle ADC is isosceles, and ∠ADC = 90º.

q_en: A vehicle moves at 65 km/h for 4 hours before slowing down to 52 km/h for the next 2.5 hours. Calculate the average speed.
e_en: Given: Speed₁ = 65 km/h, Time₁ = 4 hours Speed₂ = 52 km/h, Time₂ = 2.5 hours Formula used: Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time Total Distance = Speed₁ × Time₁ + Speed₂ × Time₂ Total Time = Time₁ + Time₂ Calculation: Total Distance = 65 × 4 + 52 × 2.5 ⇒ Total Distance = 260 + 130 ⇒ Total Distance = 390 km Total Time = 4 + 2.5 ⇒ Total Time = 6.5 hours Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time ⇒ Average Speed = 390 ÷ 6.5 ⇒ Average Speed = 60 km/h ∴ The correct answer i…

q_en: A printer with a marked price of ₹9,000 is offered on successive discounts of 30%, 20%, and 15%. Identify the printer's selling price.
e_en: Given: Marked Price (MP) = ₹9,000 Successive Discounts = 30%, 20%, 15% Formula used: Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 - Discount₁/100) × (1 - Discount₂/100) × (1 - Discount₃/100) Calculation: SP = 9000 × (1 - 30/100) × (1 - 20/100) × (1 - 15/100) ⇒ SP = 9000 × 0.7 × 0.8 × 0.85 ⇒ SP = 9000 × 0.476 ⇒ SP = ₹4,284 ∴ The correct answer is option (C).

q_en: The LCM of 2/3, 5/6, 5/12 and 7/18 is:
e_en: Given: Numbers: 2/3, 5/6, 5/12, 7/18 Formula used: LCM of fractions = LCM of numerators / HCF of denominators Calculation: Numerators: 2, 5, 5, 7 Denominators: 3, 6, 12, 18 LCM of numerators = LCM(2, 5, 5, 7) ⇒ LCM = 70 HCF of denominators = HCF(3, 6, 12, 18) ⇒ HCF = 3 ⇒ LCM of fractions = LCM of numerators / HCF of denominators ⇒ LCM = 70 / 3 ∴ The correct answer is option (C).

q_en: A’s income and expenditure are in the ratio 5 : 4. If his total savings are ₹56,000, what is his expenditure in ₹?
e_en: Given: Income and expenditure ratio of A = 5:4 Total savings = ₹56,000 Formula Used: Savings = Income - Expenditure Calculation: Income = 5x Expenditure = 4x Savings = Income - Expenditure = 5x - 4x Savings = 5x - 4x ⇒ x = Savings Given savings = ₹56,000 ⇒ x = ₹56,000 Expenditure = 4x ⇒ Expenditure = 4 × ₹56,000 ⇒ Expenditure = ₹2,24,000 The expenditure of A is ₹2,24,000.

q_en: 16 women can finish a task in 20 days and 20 men take 32 days to finish the same task. How many days will 8 women and 16 men take to finish the same task?
e_en: Given: 16 women can finish a task in 20 days. 20 men can finish the same task in 32 days. We need to find how many days 8 women and 16 men will take to finish the task. Formula Used: Work efficiency = Total work / Time taken Total work is constant, and efficiency is directly proportional to the number of workers and inversely proportional to the time taken. To solve combined work, we use the Least Common Multiple (LCM) method.

q_en: A start from X at 9:00 A.M. and reaches Y at 1:00 P.M. on the same day, B also starts from Y at 9:00 A.M. and reaches X at 3:00 P.M. on the same day, following the same route as A. At what time do the two meet?
e_en: Given: A starts from X at 9:00 A.M. and reaches Y at 1:00 P.M. (time taken = 4 hours). B starts from Y at 9:00 A.M. and reaches X at 3:00 P.M. (time taken = 6 hours). The distance between X and Y is the same for both A and B. Formula Used: Relative Speed = Speed of A + Speed of B Distance = Speed × Time Meeting time = Distance covered by A or B till meeting point / Relative Speed Calculation: Let the distance between X and Y = D. Speed of A = D / 4. Speed of B = D / 6.

e_en: Given: Principal (P) = ₹3000 Rate of interest (R) = 6% per year Time (T) = 6 years Formula Used: Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100 Calculation: SI = (3000 × 6 × 6) / 100 ⇒ SI = (3000 × 36) / 100 ⇒ SI = 108000 / 100 ⇒ SI = 1080 The simple interest is ₹1080.

q_en: If the cost price of a house is 86% of the selling price, then what is the profit percentage, correct up to two decimals?
e_en: Given: Cost Price (CP) = 86% of Selling Price (SP). Formula Used: Profit Percentage = [(SP - CP) / CP] × 100 Calculation: Let SP = 100 (Assume Selling Price for simplicity). CP = 86% of SP = 86/100 × SP = 86. Profit = SP - CP ⇒ Profit = 100 - 86 = 14 Profit Percentage = (Profit / CP) × 100 ⇒ Profit Percentage = (14 / 86) × 100 ⇒ Profit Percentage = 1627 / 100 ⇒ Profit Percentage = 16.27% The profit percentage is 16.27% (correct to two decimals).

q_en: The average age of a mother and her daughter is 42 years. The ratio of their ages is 9 : 5, respectively. Find the daughter’s age (in years).
e_en: Given: The average age of mother and daughter = 42 years. The ratio of their ages = 9 : 5. Formula Used: Mother’s age = 9x, Daughter’s age = 5x Average age = (Mother’s age + Daughter’s age) / 2 Calculation: Let the mother’s age = 9x and the daughter’s age = 5x. Average age = (9x + 5x) / 2 ⇒ (14x) / 2 = 42 ⇒ 7x = 42 ⇒ x = 42 / 7 ⇒ x = 6 Daughter’s age = 5x = 5 × 6 = 30 The daughter’s age is 30 years.

q_en: The HCF of 28, 35 and 42 is:

e_en: Given: Cost Price (C.P) = ₹70 Selling Price (S.P) = ₹90 Formula Used: Gain Percentage = (Gain / Cost Price) × 100 Where Gain = Selling Price - Cost Price Calculation: Gain = S.P - C.P ⇒ Gain = 90 - 70 ⇒ Gain = ₹20 Gain Percentage = (Gain / C.P) × 100 ⇒ Gain Percentage = (20 / 70) × 100 ⇒ Gain Percentage = (2 / 7) × 100 ⇒ Gain Percentage = 28.57% The gain percentage is 28.57%.

q_en: The height of a cylindrical pillar is 20 m. The diameter of its base is 350 cm. What will be the cost of painting the curved surface of the pillar at 40/m²? ( pi = 22/7 )
e_en: Given: Height of the cylindrical pillar (h) = 20 m. Diameter of the base = 350 cm = 3.5 m (since 1 m = 100 cm). Radius of the base (r) = Diameter / 2 = 3.5 / 2 = 1.75 m. Cost of painting = ₹40 per m². π = 22/7 Formula Used: Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = 2 × π × r × h. Total cost of painting = CSA × Cost per m². Calculation: Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × 22/7 × 1.75 × 20 ⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 1.75 × 20 / 7 ⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 35 / 7 ⇒ CSA = 2 × 110 ⇒ CSA = 220 m².

q_en: The diameter of the base of a right circular cylinder is 98 cm and its height is 42 cm. Find the total surface area of the cylinder. (Take pi = 22/7 )
e_en: Given: Diameter of the base (d) = 98 cm Radius of the base (r) = d / 2 = 98 / 2 = 49 cm Height (h) = 42 cm Formula used: Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cylinder = 2πr(h + r) Calculation: TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 49 × (42 + 49) ⇒ TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 49 × 91 ⇒ TSA = 2 × 22 × 7 × 91 ⇒ TSA = 28028 cm² ∴ The total surface area of the cylinder is 28028 cm², and the correct answer is option (B).

q_en: The product of LCM and HCF of two numbers is 24. If the difference between the two numbers is 2, then find the numbers.
e_en: Given: LCM × HCF = 24 Difference of numbers = 2 Formula used: For two numbers x and y: x × y = LCM × HCF Calculations: Let numbers be x and y, with x > y. ⇒ x × y = 24 ⇒ Also, x – y = 2 ⇒ x – y = 2 and x × y = 24 Put x = y + 2 ⇒ (y + 2) × y = 24 ⇒ y² + 2y = 24 ⇒ y² + 2y – 24 = 0 ⇒ (y + 6)(y – 4) = 0 ⇒ y = 4 or –6 (take positive) ⇒ y = 4, then x = 6 ∴ The numbers are 6 and 4.

q_en: By selling a book for ₹480 at marked price, a shopkeeper gains 20%. During a clearance sale, the shopkeeper allows a discount of 10% on the marked price. What is his gain per cent during the sale?
e_en: Given: Marked Price (MP) = ₹480 Gain at MP = 20% Discount during sale = 10% on MP Formula used: Cost Price (CP) = MP ÷ (1 + Gain%) Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 – Discount%) Gain% = [(SP – CP) ÷ CP] × 100 Calculations: ⇒ CP = 480 ÷ 1.2 = 400 ⇒ Sale SP = 480 × 0.9 = 432 ⇒ Gain = 432 – 400 = 32 ⇒ Gain% = (32 ÷ 400) × 100 = 8% ∴ The gain percent during the sale is 8%.

e_en: Given: Radius (r) = 36 cm Height (h) = 105 cm Formula used: Tot al Surface Area of Cone = π × r × (r + l) Where, l = slant height = √(r² + h²) Calculation: l = √(r² + h²) ⇒ l = √(36² + 105²) ⇒ l = √(1296 + 11025) = √12321 ⇒ l = 111 cm Total Surface Area = π × r × (r + l) ⇒ Total Surface Area = (22/7) × 36 × (36 + 111) ⇒ Total Surface Area = (22/7) × 36 × 147 ⇒ Total Surface Area = 16632 cm² ∴ The correct answer is option (A).

q_en: The average score of boys in an examination in a school is 71 and that of the girls is 73. The average score of the school is 71.8. The ratio of the number of boys to that of the girls that appeared in the examination is:

q_en: The rate of interest p.a. at which a sum becomes three times of itself in 20 years at simple interest will be:
e_en: Given: Sum becomes 3 times of itself Time (t) = 20 years Formula used: Simple Interest (SI) = Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T) / 100 Total Amount = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI) Calculation: Amount = 3 × Principal Let Principal = P Simple Interest = Amount - Principal = 3P - P = 2P SI = P × R × T / 100 ⇒ 2P = P × R × 20 / 100 ⇒ R = (2P × 100) / (P × 20) ⇒ R = 200 / 20 ⇒ R = 10% ∴ The correct answer is option (A).

q_en: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹360 in 3 years at 8% per year rate of interest?

q_en: If 45% of the sum of the two numbers is equal to 60% of the difference between the two numbers, find the ratio of the smallest number to the greatest number.

q_en: A thief is spotted by a policeman at a distance of 300 m. the policeman chases the thief at speed of 10 km/h and the thief is running at a speed of 11 km/h, then the distance between them after 12 minutes is:

q_en: A student's final grade is determined by their final examination scores (weighted at 60%) and a final project score (weighted at 40%). If the student scores 75 in the final examination and 90 in the project, then the final grade of the student is:
e_en: Given: Final examination score = 75 Final project score = 90 Weight of final examination = 60% Weight of final project = 40% Formula Used: Final grade = (Final examination score × Weight of final examination) + (Final project score × Weight of final project) Calculation: Weight of final examination = 60/100 = 0.6 Weight of final project = 40/100 = 0.4 Final grade = (75 × 0.6) + (90 × 0.4) ⇒ Final grade = 45 + 36 ⇒ Final grade = 81 The final grade of the student is 81.

q_en: Which of the following is true about average?
o_en: The average of six consecutive even integers is an even natural number
The average of six consecutive odd integers is an odd integer.
The average of six consecutive odd integers is an even integer.
The average of six consecutive odd integers is an odd natural number.
e_en: Given: Six consecutive odd integers Formula used: Average of n consecutive integers = Median of the sequence Calculation: Let the six consecutive odd integers be: a, a+2, a+4, a+6, a+8, a+10 The median of these integers (since they are in sequence) is the average of the 3rd and 4th terms: ⇒ Median = (a+4 + a+6)/2 ⇒ Median = (2a + 10)/2 ⇒ Median = a + 5 Since a is an odd integer, a+5 will be even. ∴ The correct answer is option (C).

q_en: Ajit walks around a circular field at the speed of two rounds per hour, while Mohit runs around it at the speed of 10 rounds per hour. They start in the same direction from the same point at 6:30 a.m. Find the time at which they cross each other.
e_en: Given: Ajit's speed = 2 rounds/hour Mohit's speed = 10 rounds/hour Start time = 6:30 a.m. Formula Used: Relative speed (same direction) = Speed of faster person - Speed of slower person Time to cross = Distance (1 round) / Relative speed Calculations: Relative speed = 10 - 2 = 8 rounds/hour Time to cross = 1 round / 8 rounds/hour = 1/8 hour 1/8 hour = (1/8) × 60 minutes = 7.5 minutes Crossing time = Start time + Time to cross Crossing time = 6:30 a.m.

q_en: 24 boys and a certain number of girls appeared for an exam. The average score of the boys was 42 and the average score of the girls was 34, while the combined average score was 38. How many girls appeared for the exam?
e_en: Given: Number of boys = 24 Average score of boys = 42 Average score of girls = 34 Combined average score = 38 Calculation: Let the number of girls be x . Total score of boys = 24 × 42 = 1008 Total score of girls = x × 34 Using the combined average score formula: (1008 + 34x)/(24 + x) = 38 ⇒ 1008 + 34x = 38(24 + x) ⇒ 1008 + 34x = 912 + 38x ⇒ 1008 - 912 = 38x - 34x ⇒ 96 = 4x x = 96/4 x = 24 The number of girls appeared for the exam is 24.

q_en: Two bicycle riders started at a speed of 7 m/sec and 8 m/sec on a circular path in opposite directions at the same point. If the circumference of the circle is 300 m, then in what time will they first meet?
e_en: Given: Speed of first rider = 7 m/sec Speed of second rider = 8 m/sec Circumference of the circle = 300 m Formula used: Time = Distance / Relative Speed Calculation: Relative Speed = 7 + 8 = 15 m/sec Distance to meet = Circumference = 300 m ⇒ Time = 300 / 15 ⇒ Time = 20 sec ∴ The correct answer is option C.

q_en: The price of a product increased by 20%. After some time, it decreased by 15%. What is the overall percentage change in the price?
e_en: Given: First increase (r1) = 20% Second decrease (r2) = -15% Formula used: Overall % change = r1 + r2 + (r1 × r2)/100 Calculations: Overall % change = 20 + (-15) + (20 × -15)/100 ⇒ Overall % change = 20 - 15 - 300/100 ⇒ Overall % change = 5 - 3 = 2% ∴ The overall percentage change in the price is 2%.

Sum of numbers = 27n New sum of numbers = 27n + 69 - 12 New average = 32.7 ⇒ 32.7 = (27n + 57) / n ⇒ 32.7n = 27n + 57 ⇒ 32.7n - 27n = 57 ⇒ 5.7n = 57 ⇒ n = 57 / 5.7 ⇒ n = 10 ∴ The correct answer is option (D).

q_en: An iron ball of radius 20 cm is melted and recast into 64 spherical balls of same radius. Find the radius of each spherical ball.

Formula used: Volume of sphere = 4/3pi r³ Volume of iron ball = Volume of 64 small balls 4/3pi R³ = 64 times 4/3pi r³ Calculations: 4/3pi (20)³ = 64 times 4/3pi r³ ⇒ 20³ = 64 times r³ ⇒ 8000 = 64 times r³ ⇒ r³ = 8000/64 ⇒ r³ = 125 ⇒ r = 5 cm ∴ The radius of each spherical ball is 5 cm.

q_en: x, y and z are divisible by 2, 3 and 4, respectively. What is the highest common factor (HCF) of 6x, 4y and 3z?

q_en: From a square with area a² another square made on mid points of the sides of the square is removed. What is the area left in the square?
e_en: Given: Area of outer square = a² Formula Used: Area of square = (side)² Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height Calculation: Side of outer square = a Midpoints form a smaller square. Triangles at corners are right-angled with sides a/2. Area of 1 triangle = 1/2 × a/2 × a/2 = a²/8 Area of 4 triangles = 4 × a²/8 = a²/2 Area left = Area of outer square - Area of 4 triangles ⇒ Area left = a² - a²/2 ⇒ Area left = a²/2 ∴ The area left in the square is a²/2.

e_en: Given: Speed of the thief's bike = 28 m/s Speed of the policeman's car = 30 m/s Initial separation between the thief and the policeman = 400 m Formula Used: Relative speed = Speed of the policeman's car - Speed of the thief's bike Time = Distance / Relative speed Calculation: Relative speed = 30 m/s - 28 m/s Relative speed = 2 m/s Time = Distance / Relative speed Time = 400 m / 2 m/s Time = 200 seconds The time it will take for the policeman to catch the thief is 200 seconds.

q_en: In an election, 750 votes were cast for the two contestants, Bharti and Manya. Bharti defeated Manya by 16% votes. If there were no invalid vote, then how many votes did Manya get?
e_en: Given: Total votes = 750 Bharti defeated Manya by 16% votes. Calculation: Let the number of votes Manya received be x. Then, the number of votes Bharti received is (750 - x). Since Bharti defeated Manya by 16% of the total votes, we have the equation: (Votes of Bharti) = (Votes of Manya) + 16% of total votes 750 - x = x + (16/100) × 750 750 - x = x + 120 Now, solve for x: 750 - 120 = 2x 630 = 2x x = 630 / 2 x = 315 Therefore, Manya received 315 votes.

q_en: Find the HCF of 36 and 84.
e_en: Given: We need to find the HCF (Highest Common Factor) of 36 and 84. Concept used: We will use the prime factorization method to find the HCF. Calculation: 36 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 = 2² × 3² 84 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7 = 2² × 3 × 7 The common prime factors are 2² and 3. HCF = 2² × 3 = 4 × 3 = 12 Therefore, the HCF of 36 and 84 is 12.

q_en: The population of a village is increased by 3%. Had there been 122 less, there would have been a decrease of 1%. Find the original population.
e_en: Given: Let the original population be P. Increased population = P + 3% of P = P + 0.03P = 1.03P If there were 122 less, the population would be P - 122. In this case, there would have been a decrease of 1%, so the population would be P - 1% of P = P - 0.01P = 0.99P. Calculation: 1.03P - 122 = 0.99P ⇒ 1.03P - 0.99P = 122 ⇒ 0.04P = 122 ⇒ P = 122 / 0.04 ⇒ P = 3050 ∴ The original population of the village is 3050.

q_en: A tradesman marks his goods 25% above the cost price and allows his customers 12% reduction on their bills. What percentage profit does he make?
e_en: Given: Cost Price (CP) = 100 units Marked Price (MP) = 25% above CP = 100 + 25 = 125 units Discount = 12% Formula Used: Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 - Discount%) Profit% = [(SP - CP) / CP] × 100 Calculation: MP = 125 Discount = 12% SP = MP × (1 - Discount%) ⇒ SP = 125 × (1 - 12/100) ⇒ SP = 125 × 0.88 ⇒ SP = 110 Profit = SP - CP ⇒ Profit = 110 - 100 ⇒ Profit = 10 Profit% = (Profit / CP) × 100 ⇒ Profit% = (10 / 100) × 100 ⇒ Profit% = 10% The tradesman makes a profit of 10%.

Ratio = Percentage / 100 Calculation: 29.5% = 29.5 / 100 ⇒ Ratio = 29.5 : 100 To simplify the ratio, multiply both terms by 10 to remove the decimal: ⇒ Ratio = (29.5 × 10) : (100 × 10) ⇒ Ratio = 295 : 1000 Simplify by dividing both terms by their greatest common divisor (GCD): GCD of 295 and 1000 is 5.

q_en: Two athletes X and Y are jogging on a circular path whose circumference is 500 m. Athlete X jogs at a speed of 18 km/h and Y jog at 9 km/h, jogging in opposite directions. The time at which they will meet for the first time is:
e_en: Given: Speed of Athlete X = 18 km/h Speed of Athlete Y = 9 km/h Circumference of circular path = 500 m Formula used: Relative speed = Speed of X + Speed of Y Time to meet = Distance / Relative speed Calculation: Relative speed = 18 km/h + 9 km/h = 27 km/h ⇒ 27 km/h = 27 × (5 / 18) = 7.5 m/s Time to meet = Distance / Relative speed ⇒ Time = 500 / 7.5 = 66.66 seconds ∴ The correct answer is option (A).

q_en: In a circular race of 1 km, two persons X and Y start with the speed of 9 km/h and 18 km/h, respectively, at the same time from the same point. When will they meet for the first time at the starting point when running in the same direction?
e_en: Given: Speed of X = 9 km/h Speed of Y = 18 km/h Distance of the circular track = 1 km Formula used: Time taken to meet at the starting point = Distance / Relative Speed Relative speed when running in the same direction = Speed of Y - Speed of X Calculation: Relative speed = 18 - 9 = 9 km/h Time taken to meet = Distance / Relative Speed ⇒ Time = 1 / 9 hours ⇒ Time = (1 / 9) × 3600 seconds = 400 seconds ∴ The correct answer is option (A).

q_en: The curved surface area of a right circular cylinder is 8580 cm². If the height of the cylinder is 15 cm, then find the diameter (in cm) of the circular base. (Take pi = 22/7 )
e_en: Given: Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 8580 cm² Height (h) = 15 cm Formula used: Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = 2πrh Where, r = radius Calculation: 8580 = 2 × (22/7) × r × 15 ⇒ r = (8580 × 7) / 660 = 91 cm Diameter = 2 × r = 2 × 91 ⇒ Diameter = 182 cm ∴ The correct answer is option (A).

q_en: The ratio of the present age of A and B is 3 : 1. Five years ago, the ratio of their ages was 5 : 1. The age of A (in years) after eight years will be:
e_en: Given: The present age ratio of A and B = 3 : 1 Five years ago, their age ratio = 5 : 1 Calculation: Let the present ages of A and B be 3x and x respectively. Five years ago, their ages were (3x - 5) and (x - 5). (3x - 5)/(x - 5) = 5/1 ⇒ 3x - 5 = 5(x - 5) ⇒ 3x - 5 = 5x - 25 ⇒ 3x - 5x = -25 + 5 ⇒ -2x = -20 ⇒ x = 10 Present age of A = 3x = 3 × 10 = 30 years Age of A after 8 years = 30 + 8 = 38 years ∴ The correct answer is option (C).

q_en: Three numbers are in the ratio of 6:7:3 and their LCM is 3654. Their HCF is:
e_en: Given: Three numbers are in the ratio of 6:7:3 and their LCM is 3654. Formula used: Product of numbers = HCF × LCM If numbers are in the ratio a:b:c, then actual numbers = HCF × a, HCF × b, HCF × c Calculations: Let the HCF of the numbers be x. The numbers are 6x, 7x, and 3x. LCM of 6x, 7x, and 3x = 3654 LCM of 6, 7, and 3 is 42. ⇒ LCM of 6x, 7x, 3x = 42 × x ⇒ 42 × x = 3654 ⇒ x = 3654 ÷ 42 ⇒ x = 87 ∴ The HCF is 87, and the correct answer is option (B).

q_en: Among five rods, P, Q, R, S and T, the weight of T is 20 kg. The weight of S is half the weight of P. The weight of Q is one-fourth the weight of P. R's weight is twice the weight of Q. The weight of P is twice the weight of T. Which rod is the lightest among all?
e_en: Given: The weight of T = 20 kg. Calculation: 1. The weight of P is twice the weight of T: P = 2 × T P = 2 × 20 P = 40 kg 2.
